visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a young woman with shoulder-length brown hair and blunt bangs. She wears a maroon sweatshirt with white lettering. She holds a small white and red box featuring a garlic bulb illustration. The background is a plain white wall with a pink rabbit plushie and a "KIKIEAT" wall decal. (2) She rotates the box to show the back side, which contains a layout of instructions including diagrams of the garlic bulb's internal structure and assembly steps. Her hands are steady as she points to the Japanese text and red-bordered instructional icons. (3) The scene cuts to a top-down view of a light-colored wooden table. A plastic bag is opened, and six pale yellow, plastic garlic cloves are poured out onto the surface. The woman is seated behind the table, her upper body visible as she prepares to start the puzzle. (4) A series of close-up shots show her fingers meticulously trying to arrange the garlic cloves within the bottom half of a white plastic bulb shell. Her facial expressions transition from confident smiles to looks of deep concentration and slight annoyance as the pieces fail to align properly. (5) She holds two specific garlic pieces up to the camera lens to highlight their nearly identical but critically different shapes. She makes a face of confusion, staring directly into the lens to emphasize the difficulty of the task to the audience. (6) After many attempts, she successfully snaps the top of the white garlic bulb shell onto the base. She holds the completed, smooth white garlic model in her hands, her face lit up with a triumphant smile, and she shakes the model slightly. (7) The final phase shows her holding the assembled garlic while talking to the camera. She demonstrates how the pieces fit by opening and closing the shell again, offering a final recommendation of the product with animated hand gestures and a friendly expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-arousal, fast-paced female speech delivered in a bright, energetic tone. A high-tempo electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat and bright synth textures plays consistently in the background. The speech is clear and professionally projected. (2) As the puzzle assembly begins, a male voice is heard laughing and providing brief commentary from off-camera. The female voice responds with varying pitch contours, moving from high-pitched excitement to lower, more frustrated tones. The BGM remains at a moderate volume bed. (3) Periodic sharp, percussive plastic clicking sounds occur as the garlic pieces are handled and dropped onto the wooden table. These transients are brief but distinct against the speech and music mix, matching the physical puzzle assembly. (4) Upon solving the puzzle, the female voice becomes extremely loud and high-pitched, expressing success through a comedic, exaggerated exclamation. The BGM continues until the end, where the narration returns to a friendly, informative closing style. (5) The final segment features a more relaxed speech rate as she summarizes her experience. The interaction between the vocal track and the BGM is balanced, with the music ducking slightly during speech to maintain high articulation clarity and a solid signal-to-noise ratio.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide an entertaining and humorous review of a deceptively difficult garlic-themed puzzle toy. The creator contrasts her confidence as someone experienced in peeling real garlic with the actual challenge of the product, ending with a positive recommendation.
